title: Interactions
identity: David Bomberg's Interactions is catalogued by a retailer as soprano saxophone and piano, Dorn DORN0136. Tom Bergeron's independent saxophone-multiphonics reference (third edition, 2020; originally published 1989) lists Interactions (1980) with four coded fingering/pitch combinations. This reference is technical context, not the work's score.

evidence.claim: Publisher/retailer identifies Interactions for soprano saxophone and piano, Dorn Publications.
